# Frappe Framework v16

> Technical documentation of Frappe Framework (v16) for app developers, desk users and AI agents. Verified against the source code of this version.

## Getting Started

- [Installation](getting-started/installation.md): Install the bench CLI, create a bench with Frappe version 16, create a site and start the development server.
- [Architecture](getting-started/architecture.md): How a Frappe bench, its sites and apps fit together, how a request is handled, and which processes run beside the web server.
- [Quickstart](getting-started/quickstart.md): Build a small Frappe app end to end with a DocType, a controller validation, a whitelisted method, a form script, a list view setting and a test.
- [Glossary](getting-started/glossary.md): Short definitions of the terms used in the Frappe Framework and its documentation.

## User Guide

### Desk Basics

- [Desk](user-guide/basics/desk.md): Find your way around the Frappe desk - login, apps screen, dock, sidebar, workspaces, search, notifications, user menu and keyboard shortcuts.
- [List View](user-guide/basics/list-view.md): Find, filter, sort and select documents in the desk list view, run bulk actions, and set list settings and saved layouts.
- [Views](user-guide/basics/views.md): Show the documents of a DocType as a report, kanban board, calendar, gantt chart, tree, dashboard, image grid, map or email inbox.
- [Form View](user-guide/basics/form-view.md): Read and change one document in the desk form - layout, save, submit, cancel and amend, timeline, attachments, sharing, print, email, links, duplicate, rename and form shortcuts.
- [Search](user-guide/basics/search.md): Find pages and documents with the awesomebar, global search, list filters and tags, and control what global search indexes.
- [Collaboration](user-guide/basics/collaboration.md): Work on documents with other users - assignments and ToDo, sharing, comments and mentions, likes, follow, tags, activity and the notification log.

### Users and Permissions

- [Users and Roles](user-guide/users-and-permissions/users-and-roles.md): Create users, give them roles, group roles with Role Profiles, limit modules with Module Profiles, and set password, login and two-factor rules.
- [Role Permissions](user-guide/users-and-permissions/permissions.md): Set what each role can do on each DocType with the Role Permissions Manager, permission levels, rights, "Only If Creator" and custom Permission Types.
- [User Permissions](user-guide/users-and-permissions/user-permissions.md): Limit a user to specific records with User Permission, including applicable DocTypes, default values, descendants, strict mode and the permitted documents report.

### Customization

- [Customize Form](user-guide/customization/customize-form.md): Change the fields, layout and properties of a standard DocType from the desk with Customize Form, Custom Field and Property Setter.
- [Workflow](user-guide/customization/workflow.md): Move documents through approval states with Workflow, Workflow State, transitions and Workflow Action.

### Automation and Email

- [Automation](user-guide/automation/automation.md): Assign documents with Assignment Rule, repeat documents with Auto Repeat, set Reminders, track Milestones, and name documents with Document Naming Rule and Document Naming Settings.
- [Automation Flow](user-guide/automation/automation-flow.md): Run a series of actions when a document changes, on a date, on a schedule or on a custom event, with Automation Flow, runs and Automation Settings.
- [Notifications](user-guide/automation/notifications.md): Send email, in-app, SMS or Slack alerts when documents change, with the Notification DocType, Notification Log and Notification Settings.
- [Email](user-guide/automation/email.md): Set up Email Account and Email Domain, watch the Email Queue, reuse text with Email Template, schedule Auto Email Report, and handle unsubscribes.

### Data, Reports and Printing

- [Data Import and Export](user-guide/data-and-reports/data-import-export.md): Insert or update many records from CSV, Excel or Google Sheets with Data Import, fix invalid values, read the import log, and export records with Data Export.
- [Reports](user-guide/data-and-reports/reports.md): Build and save Report Builder reports, run Query and Script Reports, use prepared reports for slow reports, and export results to Excel or CSV.
- [Dashboards](user-guide/data-and-reports/dashboards.md): Show counts and charts with Number Card and Dashboard Chart, group them in a Dashboard, and add them to workspaces.
- [Printing](user-guide/data-and-reports/printing.md): Print documents, download PDFs, and design Print Formats with the Print Format Editor, Jinja HTML or raw commands, plus Letter Head and Print Settings.

### Website and Integrations

- [Website](user-guide/website-and-integrations/website.md): Publish Web Pages and Web Forms, set up the site header, footer and home page in Website Settings, run the portal for website users, and track visits.
- [Integrations](user-guide/website-and-integrations/integrations.md): Connect a Frappe site to other systems with Webhooks, Slack Webhook URLs, OAuth clients and provider settings, Connected Apps, Social Login Keys, LDAP, Google settings and push notifications.

### AI and App Builder

- [Flow](user-guide/ai-and-app-builder/flow.md): Chat with AI agents that work on your Frappe site, connect a model provider, and set up agents, tools, skills, knowledge, memories and triggers.
- [Studio](user-guide/ai-and-app-builder/studio.md): Build web apps on a Frappe site with Studio, a visual editor with drag and drop components, data sources, variables, scripts and one-click publish.

### System Administration

- [System Settings](user-guide/system-administration/system-settings.md): Site-wide settings in System Settings (formats, login, password, email, files, backups, scheduler), plus the basics of Website Settings and Navbar Settings.
- [Backups](user-guide/system-administration/backups.md): Take, download, schedule, encrypt and restore site backups with bench and the Download Backups page.
- [Logs and Monitoring](user-guide/system-administration/logs-and-monitoring.md): Find errors and check site health with Error Log, Activity Log, Access Log, Scheduled Job Log, RQ Job, RQ Worker, Recorder, System Health Report, System Console and Log Settings.


## Developer Guide

### Building Apps

- [Apps](developer-guide/building-apps/apps.md): Create a Frappe app, understand its files and folders, install it on a site, and build its assets.
- [Hooks](developer-guide/building-apps/hooks.md): How hooks.py works, how hook values from all apps merge, and the hooks that apps use most.
- [Extending Other Apps](developer-guide/building-apps/extending-apps.md): Change the behavior of DocTypes and methods from another app with doc_events, controller overrides and mixins, method overrides, doctype_js, custom fields and property setters.
- [Fixtures and Patches](developer-guide/building-apps/fixtures-and-patches.md): Ship records with an app through the fixtures hook, change data on existing sites with patches, and understand the order of bench migrate.
- [Translations](developer-guide/building-apps/translations.md): Mark strings with _() in Python and __() in JS, use context and lazy strings, keep PO/POT files in an app, and run the bench translation commands.

### Data Model

- [DocTypes](developer-guide/data-model/doctypes.md): The DocType JSON, standard and custom DocTypes, the main DocType properties, child tables, singles, trees and virtual DocTypes.
- [Naming](developer-guide/data-model/naming.md): How Frappe sets the name of a document, with autoname options, naming series, the autoname controller method and rename.
- [Controllers](developer-guide/data-model/controllers.md): The Document class, controller lifecycle methods and their exact run order, doc_events, flags, db_set, change detection and whitelisted controller methods.
- [Files](developer-guide/data-model/files.md): Store and attach files with the File DocType, upload them over HTTP, and choose public or private storage.

### Database

- [Database API](developer-guide/database/database.md): Read and write data with frappe.db and frappe.get_list / get_all, the filter syntax, and when Frappe commits or rolls back a transaction.
- [Query Builder](developer-guide/database/query-builder.md): Build SQL queries in Python with frappe.qb (PyPika): DocType tables, conditions, functions, joins, subqueries and frappe.qb.get_query.

### Permissions and Security

- [Permissions](developer-guide/security/permissions.md): How the permission engine decides access from role permissions, permission levels, user permissions, sharing and app hooks, and how to check permissions in code.
- [Authentication](developer-guide/security/authentication.md): Authenticate HTTP requests with a session cookie, API key and secret, or an OAuth 2 bearer token, and how CSRF, two-factor login, guests and auth hooks work.
- [Security](developer-guide/security/security.md): Write secure Frappe app code - permission checks in whitelisted methods, safe SQL, escaping, private files, rate limits, CSRF, secrets and the risks of ignore_permissions.

### APIs

- [Whitelisted Methods](developer-guide/api/whitelisted-methods.md): Expose Python functions over HTTP with @frappe.whitelist, validate arguments with type annotations, restrict access by role, rate limit, and override methods of other apps.
- [REST API](developer-guide/api/rest-api.md): Read and change documents and call whitelisted methods over HTTP with /api/v1 (resource, method) and /api/v2 (document, doctype, method), including list parameters, responses and errors.
- [MCP and API Discovery](developer-guide/api/mcp-and-discovery.md): Connect AI agents to a site through the built-in MCP endpoint at /api/v2/mcp, and describe whitelisted methods with the /api/v2/discovery endpoints.

### Jobs, Realtime and Caching

- [Background Jobs](developer-guide/runtime/background-jobs.md): Run code outside the web request with frappe.enqueue and enqueue_doc, on RQ queues served by bench workers.
- [Scheduler](developer-guide/runtime/scheduler.md): Run functions on a schedule with the scheduler_events hook, Scheduled Job Type records and the bench schedule process.
- [Realtime](developer-guide/runtime/realtime.md): Push events from the server to browsers with publish_realtime, Socket.IO rooms and frappe.realtime.on, and add custom realtime handlers.
- [Caching](developer-guide/runtime/caching.md): Cache data in Redis with frappe.cache, read documents with get_cached_doc and get_cached_value, and use the request_cache, site_cache and redis_cache decorators.

### Desk UI

- [Form Scripts](developer-guide/desk-ui/form-scripts.md): Add client-side behavior to a desk form with frappe.ui.form.on events, the frm object API and the doctype_js hook.
- [List View Settings](developer-guide/desk-ui/list-view-settings.md): Customize the desk list, tree, calendar, gantt and kanban views of a DocType with <doctype>_list.js and the related view settings files and hooks.
- [Client API](developer-guide/desk-ui/client-api.md): Call the server, read data, show messages and dialogs, route, and format values from desk JavaScript with frappe.call, frappe.db, frappe.model, frappe.ui.Dialog and related helpers.
- [Desk Pages](developer-guide/desk-ui/desk-pages.md): Build a custom desk screen with the Page DocType, its JSON, JS, CSS and HTML files, frappe.pages events and frappe.ui.make_app_page.
- [Workspaces, Sidebar and Dock](developer-guide/desk-ui/workspaces-sidebar-dock.md): Ship desk navigation from an app with Workspace, Sidebar and Dock JSON records and the add_to_apps_screen hook.
- [Islands](developer-guide/desk-ui/islands.md): Draw desk pages and widgets with Vue islands, self-contained bundles that the desk mounts in a shadow root by name.

### Website and Portal

- [Website](developer-guide/website/website.md): Serve web pages from an app with www/ files, route rules, redirects, base templates, DocTypes with a web view, page renderers and Jinja hooks.
- [Web Forms](developer-guide/website/web-forms.md): Ship standard Web Forms in an app, add a client script and Python context, control access and list settings, and use Web Form Request keys.

### Reports, Printing and Email

- [Reports](developer-guide/output/reports.md): Build Script Reports and Query Reports in an app, define filters, return charts and summaries, run reports from code, and use prepared reports and report roles.
- [Print Formats](developer-guide/output/print-formats.md): Ship Print Formats in an app, write Jinja print templates, render HTML or PDF with frappe.get_print, choose the PDF engine and add one with the pdf_generator hook.
- [Email and Notifications](developer-guide/output/email-and-notifications.md): Send email with frappe.sendmail and the Email Queue, use Email Templates, ship Notifications in an app, log Communications, handle incoming email and create system notifications.

### Low-Code and AI

- [Server Scripts and Client Scripts](developer-guide/low-code-and-ai/server-and-client-scripts.md): Write Python Server Scripts and JavaScript Client Scripts in the desk, enable server scripts, and know the restricted API that safe_exec allows.
- [Automation Engine](developer-guide/low-code-and-ai/automation-engine.md): Extend Automation Flows from an app with the automation_events, automation_actions and automation_relationships hooks, emit() and skip_automations.
- [Flow Development](developer-guide/low-code-and-ai/flow-development.md): Ship Flow AI agents, tools and triggers from an app with frappe.flow.Agent, @tool, Trigger and the flow_agents, flow_tools and flow_triggers hooks.
- [Studio Development](developer-guide/low-code-and-ai/studio-development.md): Store Studio apps in an app repo, sync and export them, build them with bench, and pass boot data with the studio_app_boot hook.

### Testing and Performance

- [Testing](developer-guide/testing-and-performance/testing.md): Write and run tests for Frappe apps with UnitTestCase and IntegrationTestCase, test records, context managers, run-tests, run-parallel-tests and run-ui-tests.
- [Performance](developer-guide/testing-and-performance/performance.md): Keep Frappe apps fast with indexes, cached reads, fewer queries, bulk operations and background jobs, and find slow code with the Recorder, the monitor log and query profiling.

### Configuration and Operations

- [Configuration](developer-guide/operations/configuration.md): Configure a site with site_config.json and common_site_config.json, read values with frappe.conf, change them with bench set-config, and override them with environment variables.
- [Deployment](developer-guide/operations/deployment.md): Run Frappe in production with the bench CLI - processes, Procfile, supervisor or systemd, nginx, workers and queues, socketio, maintenance mode and DNS multitenancy.
- [Upgrading](developer-guide/operations/upgrading.md): Notable breaking changes from v15 to v16, how deprecations work in deprecation_dumpster, and the steps to upgrade a bench.


## Reference

### API Reference

- [Python API](reference/api/python-api.md): Public functions and objects on the frappe module, grouped by theme, with signatures and one line each.
- [Database API](reference/api/database-api.md): Methods on frappe.db with signatures, grouped by theme, and the differences between MariaDB, Postgres and SQLite.
- [Utilities](reference/api/utils.md): Commonly used helpers in frappe.utils for type conversion, dates, numbers, formatting, strings, URLs, files, HTML, passwords and caching, with signatures.
- [JavaScript API](reference/api/js-api.md): Client-side frappe namespaces in desk (frappe.call, frappe.db, frappe.model, frappe.ui, frappe.datetime, frappe.utils and more) with signatures.
- [REST Endpoints Reference](reference/api/rest-endpoints.md): Every route under /api in Frappe (v1, v2, discovery, MCP) and the most used whitelisted methods, with HTTP methods and permission checks.

### Configuration Reference

- [Hooks Reference](reference/configuration/hooks.md): Every hooks.py key that the Frappe Framework reads, with its shape, the file that reads it, and what it does.
- [Site Config Reference](reference/configuration/site-config.md): Every site_config.json and common_site_config.json key that the Frappe Framework reads, with its default and meaning.
- [CLI Reference](reference/configuration/cli.md): Every bench command that the frappe app provides, with its options and whether it needs a site.

### Data Model Reference

- [Field Types](reference/data-model/field-types.md): Every DocField fieldtype with its database column type on MariaDB, Postgres and SQLite, what Options means, and validation rules.
- [DocTypes Reference](reference/data-model/doctypes.md): Every DocType shipped with the frappe app, grouped by module, with flags and a one-line description.
